properties.description: Assigns the Demo Environment Cost Governance Initiative to the demo subscription. policyDefinitionId self-resolves to the initiative deployed in the current subscription via the subscription() function; allowedOwnerPrincipalIds defaults to an empty array and must be supplied at deployment time (see policy/scripts/deploy-policy.sh and the POLICY_PRINCIPAL_ID input on .github/workflows/deploy-policy.yml) rather than edited here.
